name: The tic-tac-toe value update

symbols.meaning: the positions before and after a greedy move

intuition: Make the earlier estimate a little more like the later, better-informed one.
assumptions: Applied only after greedy moves; exploratory moves cause no update (Figure 1.1).
significance: The book's first temporal-difference rule; Chapter 6 returns to it as TD(0) (6.2) with rewards and discounting.
pitfalls: With a constant α the values keep moving; the draft's convergence claim needs α reduced over time.
